create_BlockStatus: create a BlockStatus instance with a block_id to track KV data offloading state
check_BlockStatus_is_ready: check if a BlockStatus instance is ready to be read by inspecting its is_ready property
implement_CachePolicy_subclass: implement a CachePolicy subclass with get, insert, remove, touch, and evict methods for LRU or ARC eviction
call_CachePolicy_get: call the get method on a CachePolicy subclass to look up a BlockStatus by OffloadKey
call_CachePolicy_evict: call the evict method on a CachePolicy subclass to evict n blocks while skipping protected keys
